name: B10-0335/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission Implementing Decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize NK603 × T25 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the licence for importing a type of genetically modified maize, called NK603 × T25. This maize is engineered to survive two weedkillers, glyphosate and glufosinate. Parliament says the safety checks were incomplete, especially on long-term effects and on the weedkillers used with the crop. It also says the Commission should not approve such products when EU countries did not back the plan. This is Parliament's opinion; it does not itself change the law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to drop the renewal plan.
- **Who it affects:** Companies importing this maize for food and feed, EU farmers, and consumers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw or keep its plan; Parliament also wants new rules for deciding on genetically modified products.
